title: Module Metadata in Your Project File | Orchard Core
description:
A module, a theme, or a feature tells Orchard Core its name, category, description, author, version, and dependencies, usually through attributes in a Manifest.cs file. Many of those values exist in the project file.

The Orchard Core build targets read MSBuild item lists in the project file and write the same assembly attributes. You declare a module, its features, or a theme once, and the values can come from MSBuild properties.

In this video:
• Why describe a module in the project file
• Declare a module with an OrchardCoreModules item
• Declare features and themes, and the OrchardCoreAttributes list
• Remove Manifest.cs, the rules the build checks, and where the values show in the admin
